_comment: DID-017. Plane file: agents cannot edit it. TAILOR forbidden_imports, runners and stack to your project.
_test_dir_note: The suite lives inside the product it tests, so the repository root holds only the two projects. The runner passes --confcutdir={test_dir}: a conftest.py above the suite is outside the freeze hash, so it must not participate in the run.

baseline._comment: A freeze is an APPROVAL, not a checkpoint: it records a commit signed by a key the agent does not hold, whose tree carries the frozen suite, and verify re-checks both. Setting require_signed false reduces the lock to drift detection -- it can then no longer prove the suite predates the implementation, so a re-freeze can launder an edit. Only the harness's own test roots turn it off, in their copied policy.
